name: PR416 low-speed Rolling isolation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/pr416-state-only-preforce-candidate
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/pr416-low-speed-rolling-isolation.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  isolate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: evidence/pr416-state-only-preforce-candidate
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Keep Stationary pre-force recovery but restore old Rolling order
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git fetch origin evidence/pr416-no-rolling-focused evidence/pr416-mechanism-census
          git checkout origin/evidence/pr416-no-rolling-focused -- src/ball-physics/BallStateMachine.cs
          test "$(git hash-object src/ball-physics/BallStateMachine.cs)" = "3297dd5a90c8881c510fa1869d34821d395f2a7f"
          test "$(git hash-object src/ball-physics/BallPhysicsCore.cs)" = "b51e772bc4c9e8dd3f414d2ae372a6591294e7eb"

      - name: Install one-seed full-match census
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git show origin/evidence/pr416-mechanism-census:.github/evidence/Pr416MechanismCensusTests.cs > src/match-engine/tests/Pr416MechanismCensusTests.cs
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re
          p = Path("src/match-engine/tests/Pr416MechanismCensusTests.cs")
          s = p.read_text()
          s, ticks_n = re.subn(
              r"private const int Ticks\s*=\s*150_000;",
              "private const int Ticks = 324_000;", s, count=1)
          s, seed_n = re.subn(
              r"private static readonly ulong\[\] Seeds\s*=\s*\{.*?\};",
              "private static readonly ulong[] Seeds =\n        {\n            0x00000000D1A6D05EUL,\n        };",
              s, count=1, flags=re.S)
          if ticks_n != 1 or seed_n != 1:
              raise SystemExit(f"helper rewrite mismatch ticks={ticks_n} seeds={seed_n}")
          p.write_text(s)
          PY

      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Generate projects and restore
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln

      - name: Run isolation census
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj             --no-restore             --filter "Name=MeasurePr416MechanismCensus"             --logger "console;verbosity=detailed"
